## Rank & Rent SEO Business Model
- What Is Rank & Rent?: A digital marketing business model where you build and rank a website for a local service niche, generate qualified leads, and partner with local businesses through a Pay Per Call or lead generation arrangement.
- How It Works: 1) Identify a profitable local niche, 2) Build an SEO-optimized website, 3) Rank on Google Search and Map Pack, 4) Partner with a suitable local company, 5) Route qualified calls that convert into customers.
- Pay Per Call: Businesses pay only for qualified calls, eliminating upfront marketing risk and delivering 100% exclusive buyer-intent leads.
- Learn Rank & Rent With Anwar: Mentorship covering niche validation, site building, local SEO, GBP synergy, and deal structuring.
